name: io.github.sethiraj/mobile-security-mcp
description: Scan Android and iOS apps with MobSF: upload, static analysis, dynamic analysis on a device, and findings as normalized JSON or SARIF. Independent wrapper, not affiliated with the MobSF project.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the folder holding the apps to scan

apps_dir.description: Folder on your machine containing the .apk/.ipa files

packageArguments.description: Serve MCP over stdio instead of HTTP

environmentVariables.name: MOBSF_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your MobSF instance, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8000

environmentVariables.name: MOBSF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MobSF REST API key, from the MobSF web UI
